title: Analytics Retention Response
description: Normalized audience-retention curve, the exact shape record_analytics_retention_points() expects as its $3 (points) parameter. See docs/architecture/analytics-strategy-pipeline.md#audience-retention.

elapsed_ratio.description: Position in the video as a fraction of total duration (0 = start, 1 = end).

audience_watch_ratio.description: YouTube's absolute audience-retention value at this point (can exceed 1.0 at rewatched/spike points).

relative_retention.description: Retention relative to similar-length videos, when the provider supplies it.
